subject: Journal entry for credit claim VEN042-0028
body:
Dear Accounts lead,

Record VEN042-0028 appears in GSTR-2B for October 2025 instead of September 2025. The supplier reported the invoice one return period late, so the Rs 639 credit can be claimed only in the month it appears.

Please claim the credit in October 2025 as per the next step.
